sources.title: Introducing GPT-5 for developers
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 through the web reader after the direct-fetch cache recorded HTTP 403. The August 7, 2025 API launch identifies gpt-5-mini as a GPT-5 reasoning size and explicitly supports prompt caching and tool calling. Read identity, availability and exact-mini detailed benchmark columns; sizes are qualitative and the tables report performance, with no numerical total or active parameter specification.

sources.title: GPT-5 Mini API model documentation
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 through official documentation retrieval and read the complete current Markdown fetched HTTP 200 that day. Identifies gpt-5-mini and snapshot gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07; lists text/image input, text output, 400,000 context, 272,000 maximum input, 128,000 maximum output, reasoning, function calling, file uploads and supported API endpoints. Status is deprecated. No total/active parameter count or numerical architecture specification is provided.

sources.title: GPT-5 System Card
sources.evidence: Rechecked the complete extracted text of the original 60-page PDF freshly fetched HTTP 200 on October 27, 2026; read the introduction, model-data/training section and exact-mini evaluation context, and searched the entire extraction for parameter, size and architecture disclosures. Identifies the API mini as gpt-5-thinking-mini, distinct from gpt-5-main-mini; describes reinforcement learning. No numerical total or activated count is disclosed. The o4-mini predecessor mapping is not a statement of unchanged weights or architecture. This was a full-text search and targeted reading, not a visual inspection of every PDF page.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: Directly fetched archived guide explicitly applies to models before GPT-5.6. Explains OpenAI prompt caching through Transformer attention key/value projections and stored tensors across layers and heads. Combined with the launch explicitly enabling caching for gpt-5-mini, this supports only a broad operational Transformer inference.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: Directly fetched guide describes Responses API PDF processing for vision-capable models: extracted text and page images enter the model. Chat Completions accepts PDF file parts. Establishes the API file-format meaning of PDF when combined with this exact model's image and file-upload support.

sources.title: API deprecations
sources.evidence: Directly fetched June 11, 2026 notice lists the exact gpt-5-mini alias and gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07 snapshot for future API shutdown on December 11, 2026. Deprecation is not evidence that the endpoint has already shut down.

sources.title: Introducing GPT-5.4 mini and nano
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 through the web reader after the direct-fetch cache recorded HTTP 403. The March 17, 2026 successor announcement contains exact GPT-5 mini (high) comparison columns across coding, tools, intelligence, vision and long context. These later original OpenAI comparisons report benchmark performance, not total or active parameter counts; faster/smaller successor positioning does not establish a shared parameter count.

sources.title: All OpenAI API models
sources.evidence: Directly fetched catalog lists GPT-5 Mini among deprecated hosted models, separately from the open-weight Apache-2.0 gpt-oss section. Together with its API launch and service-access terms, supports closed, proprietary distribution.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Current section 9.1 reserves intellectual-property rights in the Services and grants limited service-use rights. Used for a descriptive proprietary classification of the documented hosted model, not as a named open-weight license or a claim about the precise contract text on launch day.

sources.title: From Hard Refusals to Safe-Completions: Toward Output-Centric Safety Training
sources.evidence: Rechecked the complete extracted text of the 27-page original PDF freshly fetched HTTP 200 on October 27, 2026 and read section 3.1 Experiment Setup. Its controlled pair is o4-mini-like, while its production pair is o3 versus GPT-5 Thinking and explicitly differs in architecture. It neither identifies a GPT-5 mini count nor establishes a named unchanged-size base-model relationship. Full-text parameter/architecture search found no exact-mini numerical disclosure; no all-page visual inspection was performed.

sources.title: GPT-5.1 Instant and GPT-5.1 Thinking System Card Addendum
sources.evidence: Reopened the complete extracted text of the five-page original addendum freshly fetched HTTP 200 on October 27, 2026. The November 12, 2025 document reports full-size GPT-5.1 Instant/Thinking safety comparisons with earlier full-size variants, not a GPT-5 mini total or active parameter count. No full-size specification is transferred to mini.

sources.title: EXAONE 4.5 Technical Report: LG’s First Open-Weight Vision-Language Model for Industrial Intelligence
sources.evidence: Freshly opened October 27, 2026. Original model-team Tables 2 and 3 identify GPT-5 mini (Reasoning: high), citing the GPT-5 system card, and explicitly separate # Total Params and # Activated Params. Both GPT-5 mini entries are dashes in both tables. This checks a later original research-team counting convention directly; it supplies neither count for GPT-5 mini and is not an OpenAI disclosure.

sources.title: EXAONE 4.5 33B official model card
sources.evidence: Freshly opened October 27, 2026 and read both Vision-Language Tasks and Language-only Tasks comparison tables. The exact GPT-5 mini (Reasoning: high) column has dashes for Architecture, Total Params and Active Params in both tables, corroborating the original EXAONE report without supplying a size.

sources.title: Evaluating Large Language Models on the 2026 Korean CSAT Mathematics Exam: Measuring Mathematical Ability in a Zero–Data-Leakage Setting
sources.publisher: Goun Pyeon et al., Chungnam National University
sources.evidence: Fresh search lead. The web reader timed out, but the original author-hosted PDF was directly fetched HTTP 200 on October 27, 2026 and its full text extracted; read section 4.1 and Table 2 on PDF page 12. The GPT-5-mini row gives approximately 27B in an active-parameter Scale column with an asterisk. The caption explicitly says unavailable scales are estimated from prior documentation and reported performance. Rejected as a performance-based estimate, not a published production-model specification or reliable independent nominal counting convention.

sources.title: Incompressible Knowledge Probes: Estimating Black-Box LLM Parameter Counts via Factual Capacity
sources.evidence: Freshly opened the original paper October 27, 2026 and read its abstract, estimation methodology, effective-capacity table context and Appendix E GPT-5-mini rows. It calibrates factual recall against open models and explicitly reports coarse effective knowledge capacity rather than precise production parameter counts. Appendix E leaves known parameter values blank for gpt-5-mini and gpt-5-mini-think. Neither black-box size estimates nor inferred lineage are adopted.

sources.title: GPT-5.4 Thinking System Card, including GPT-5.4 mini appendix
sources.evidence: Reopened the complete extracted text freshly fetched HTTP 200 on October 27, 2026, searched for exact original-mini names and parameter disclosures, and read the March 17 GPT-5.4 mini appendix comparison context. It compares the newer mini with full-size GPT-5/5.1/5.2/5.4 variants and gives safety scores, not an original GPT-5 mini total or active count. No size is transferred from this successor.

name.note: Exact current API documentation title; gpt-5-mini is the alias and gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07 is its documented snapshot.

developer.note: OpenAI announces and serves this exact API model.

family.note: The developer groups gpt-5-mini with the GPT-5 API reasoning variants. Replaces the cross-generation gpt-mini grouping.

release_date.note: The dated developer announcement explicitly states availability that day; the documented snapshot date agrees. Day precision.

open_weights.note: Documented distribution is the hosted API under service-access terms; the developer catalog separately identifies its open-weight gpt-oss releases. No open-weight distribution of GPT-5 mini is offered in the reviewed primary sources.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the hosted model and reserved service IP, not an SPDX license or a claim that current contract wording was the August 2025 wording.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 re-audit reopened the original launch, exact model documentation and full-text original system/training PDFs, then searched for later disclosures. Neither these nor OpenAI’s GPT-5.4 mini comparisons provide a total count or count-bearing named-base lineage. LG AI Research’s later EXAONE 4.5 Tables 2/3 explicitly leave total parameters blank for exact GPT-5 mini. IKP estimates effective factual capacity, not a production specification; no numerical total is supported.

active_parameters_b.note: Active parameters were checked separately, including later original model-team tables: EXAONE 4.5 Tables 2/3 explicitly leave # Activated Params blank for exact GPT-5 mini. OpenAI’s original and successor comparisons supply no active count. The CSAT paper’s approximately 27B row is explicitly estimated from documentation/performance and is rejected. No dense-equals-total, sibling-size or black-box inference is used.

architecture.note: Qualified operational cross-source inference: the original launch explicitly grants prompt caching to gpt-5-mini, and OpenAI's applicable pre-GPT-5.6 guide explains that mechanism using Transformer attention and KV tensors. The exact model page has cached pricing but no prompt_caching feature flag. This evidence does not establish a complete block inventory, exclusively Transformer layers, dense/MoE routing, dimensions or parameter counts. Inspected training research does not provide a mini-specific structural disclosure.

context_window.note: The exact model page labels 400,000 as the context window, separately from 272,000 maximum input and 128,000 maximum output tokens. These are documented limits, not an endpoint test.

modalities.note: Native model input is text/image and output is text. PDF denotes the supported API file format: its text and page images are extracted for this vision/file-upload-capable model. Hosted tools and frame-based video benchmarks do not establish native audio/video or image output.

reasoning.note: The exact model page lists reasoning tokens and the launch supports reasoning effort. System-card gpt-5-thinking-mini is the API reasoning variant, distinct from gpt-5-main-mini used in ChatGPT.

tool_call.note: Function calling is expressly supported for this exact model; the launch also covers parallel and custom tool calls.

description.value: GPT-5 reasoning variant with text and image input, text output, a 400,000-token context window and function calling.

GPT-5.4 Thinking System Card, including GPT-5.4 mini appendix

patch.notes: The gpt-5-mini API alias identifies snapshot gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07 and the GPT-5 thinking-mini variant. Total and active parameters remain undisclosed; later LG AI Research comparison tables also leave both counts blank. The 400,000-token context is distinct from 272,000 maximum input and 128,000 maximum output. PDF input is converted to text and page images. Transformer is a limited operational inference from prompt-caching support and OpenAI’s applicable KV-cache documentation; block structure and dense/MoE routing are unspecified. The model is deprecated, with shutdown announced for December 11, 2026; no endpoint call was made.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains explicit null total and active counts after fresh original OpenAI documentation, system/training-paper and later comparison checks. LG AI Research’s EXAONE 4.5 report and card expressly leave both GPT-5 mini parameter rows blank. Rejected the CSAT paper’s approximately 27B performance-based active estimate and IKP black-box capacity estimates. No count-bearing named-base lineage was established. Preserved all twelve other field assessments, including the qualified Transformer inference and documented future shutdown.
